header.observed: mBodyHealth and mBodyMaxHealth declared int; inspected with web tool, not locally blob-verified.

sourceRules: ZombieInitialize starts ordinary bodies at270, overrides pogo to500, and divides miniature health pools separately by4 using integer division before mBodyMaxHealth is recorded.
UpdateDamageStates loses the head only below integer mBodyMaxHealth /3. A500-health body remains headed at166; a125-health miniature remains headed at41.
UpdatePlaying applies3 decay damage when body maximum>=500, otherwise1, with the pre-existing20percent decay chance.
Losing the pogo object changes its movement and equipment, not its body maximum.
implementation: Shared zombieBodyHealth(kind,mini) in game/config.ts is used for spawn, headless threshold, decay and the renderer health denominator.
Almanac entry corrected to500; existing all-kind spawn/almanac integration check covers duplicate metadata.
bounds: Persistent mHasHead state and complete damage/update ordering remain outside this numeric correction.
No new resources, rendering loops, dependencies or display objects.
Normal-play regressions and actual device performance remain separate acceptance gates.
